# Loxep

> Loxep is an open-source, self-hosted platform for marketplace intelligence, multichannel commerce operations, services, inventory, billing, and financial visibility.

Loxep starts with a practical first vertical slice: continuously observe eBay listings/watchlists, retain useful history, detect meaningful changes, and notify the user. The architecture is deliberately broad enough to grow into commerce, inventory, projects/services, billing, accounting, tax, documents/media, and operational integrations.

The name combines loxodrome and ephemeris: navigation and observation over time.

Key facts:

- Source code: https://github.com/formless63/loxep
- Documentation: https://formless63.github.io/loxep/
- Self-hosted; single application image with PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB
- Stack: TanStack Start, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/formless63/loxep/main/README.md): Overview, current implementation direction, and getting started
- [Docs site](https://formless63.github.io/loxep/): Architecture documentation, ADRs, and product/domain maps
